title: Coinbase CEO says AI agents will account for '99.9%' of transactions within a decade

title: Predictions platform Kalshi complies with order to halt Trump mention contracts
content: The company confirmed that the Commodity Futures Trading Commission ordered it to stop "mention" contracts involving the U.S. president.

title: Druckenmiller says he is short copper, warns of economic weakness in 2027
content: The billionaire investor is prioritizing capital preservation and shifting his AI focus from infrastructure to applications.

title: U.S. Fed Governor Waller pitches keeping central bank at the center of tokenization
content: Waller suggested the Federal Reserve could provide trusted rails for emerging innovation tied to tokenized assets and agentic AI.

title: Hong Kong, Swift test tokenized deposits as banks chase stablecoin-style speed
content: Hong Kong and Swift expanded their efforts to connect tokenized bank deposits across currencies, building on earlier work involving digital central bank money.

title: Eastern Europe crypto flows fall 7.9% as Ukraine draws $12B in stablecoins
content: Chainalysis found that Eastern Europe recorded the steepest decline in crypto activity of any region, while cross-border stablecoin transfers to Ukraine continued amid the ongoing war.

title: Lighter incident exposes risks beyond withdrawal controls
content: Crypto platforms need enforceable limits on every route an API key can use to transfer value, including trades, internal transfers and shared pools.

title: Fed’s Waller cites Binance hack in warning over tokenized finance
content: Fed Governor Christopher Waller questioned who bears responsibility for fraud, compromised keys and failed transactions as traditional financial assets move onto blockchains.

title: Bitcoin drops 2.5% as Nvidia stock risks new 5-month lows into Q3 earnings
content: Bitcoin price downside sees local lows of $63,269 as Nvidia stock targets $150 as traders brace for volatility over Q3 earnings.

title: Bitcoin Investors Are Capitulating—That’s Historically Been a Bottom Signal
content: Glassnode says Bitcoin’s realized losses have reached levels seen only near the 2018, 2020, 2022 and early 2023 lows, as buyers defend the $62,000 to $66,000 range.

title: Cathie Wood's ARK Sells $85 Million in Nvidia, Buys $40 Million in Crypto Stocks
content: Cathie Wood's funds trimmed Nvidia ahead of earnings while buying Block, Circle and Coinbase during Monday's selloff.

title: Ethereum Devs Weigh a Scaling Upgrade That Could Break 15,000 Apps
content: Developers warned on a core dev call that two scaling changes in the Glamsterdam upgrade break assumptions some contracts rely on—pitting a 3.3x capacity boost against the risk of disrupting thousands of apps.

title: Jensen Huang Says He'd Be 'Honored' to Return as Nvidia CEO, Despite Board's Resistance
content: The ousted Nvidia founder apologized for his conduct, offered to return if directors ask, and addressed supporters as the chipmaker presses ahead with its search for new leadership this week.

title: Binance Hack Wallets Move $137 Million in Ethereum After Two Weeks of Silence
content: A wallet linked to October’s record Binance theft moved $63 million in ether, before analysts flagged a larger wave of transfers and reported Bitcoin swaps amid ongoing U.S. recovery efforts.

title: Situational Awareness Dumps Bitcoin Miners After Citadel Sale
content: Bitcoin Magazine Situational Awareness Dumps Bitcoin Miners After Citadel Sale Situational Awareness, the AI fund run by Leopold Aschenbrenner, cut IREN about 94% and exited Core Scientific, Riot and Hive in the third quarter, leaving $80.8 million in three miner stocks after a July sale to Citadel. This post Situational Awareness Dumps Bitcoin Miners After Citadel Sale first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Coinbase Launches ChatGPT Plugin for Trading Bitcoin, Stocks, and Derivatives
content: Bitcoin Magazine Coinbase Launches ChatGPT Plugin for Trading Bitcoin, Stocks, and Derivatives Coinbase launched an official ChatGPT plugin Tuesday that lets users connect an account and trade bitcoin, other crypto, stocks and derivatives in the chat, approving every order. The official plugin is currently available to U.S. users. This post Coinbase Launches ChatGPT Plugin for Trading Bitcoin, Stocks, and Derivatives first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Trezor Shipping Partner Breach Exposes 27,000 Orders as Customers Report Scam Calls
content: Bitcoin Magazine Trezor Shipping Partner Breach Exposes 27,000 Orders as Customers Report Scam Calls A breach at shipping partner Skladon exposed names, addresses, emails, phone numbers and purchase details for about 27,000 Trezor orders, the company said, and some customers have already reported scam calls. Wallet backups were not involved. This post Trezor Shipping Partner Breach Exposes 27,000 Orders as Customers Report Scam Calls first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Wells Fargo More Than Doubles Its Bitcoin ETF Stake to $2.35 Billion
content: Bitcoin Magazine Wells Fargo More Than Doubles Its Bitcoin ETF Stake to $2.35 Billion Wells Fargo's third-quarter 13F shows 49.6 million IBIT shares worth $2.35 billion at Sept. 30, up from 24.4 million, while its Strategy stake fell about 33% to 1.34 million shares. This post Wells Fargo More Than Doubles Its Bitcoin ETF Stake to $2.35 Billion first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
